shots.subject: a shop's shutters half raised at dawn, the street outside still empty
a set of brass scales on a counter, one pan settled lower than the other
five shipping containers stacked on a dock, each one a different colour
three funnels of different widths on a workbench, the narrowest still dripping
a tool wall in a workshop, seven outlines bare where the tools have been taken
a crossroads from above at dusk, four roads meeting on an empty square
a warm loaf passed across a counter, both hands cupped underneath it
a tape recorder running on a cafe table between two cooling cups
a tray of loose buttons sorted into shallow dishes by colour and by size
a supermarket aisle at night, fully lit and empty of shoppers
a rack of cooling fans turning behind a steel grille, lit from within
a loading bay at first light, four wrapped pallets waiting on the concrete
a stopwatch face up on a bare table, the second hand mid sweep
one chair pulled out from a long empty table, lit hard from one side
a shop's lights going off one bank at a time, the wet street outside
